title: A systems biology approach reveals dual neurotherapeutic mechanisms of Dioscorea bulbifera in Alzheimer's disease via estrogen signaling and cholinergic modulation.
authors: Chowdhury, Mayank Roy; Vijaykumar, Sudarshana Deepa
one_liner_zh: 该文用系统生物学、分子对接和MD研究中药活性成分与阿尔茨海默病靶点（ESR1、ACHE）的互作，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接与模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a multifactorial neurodegenerative disorder marked by cognitive decline, cholinergic dysfunction, synaptic loss, and neuroinflammation. Existing therapies such as Donepezil and estrogen replacement offer only symptomatic relief, failing to address the complexity of the disease due to their reductionist, single-targeted approach. In this study, we employed an integrative systems biology framework to evaluate the neurotherapeutic potential of Dioscorea bulbifera (DB), a core component of the US-patented polyherbal formulation BHD (comprising Bacopa monnieri, Hippophae rhamnoides, and DB), which has shown promising neuroprotective properties in preclinical models. We identified active phytoconstituents of DB-including Emodin, Beta-sitosterol, Diosgenin, Stigmasterol, Diosbulbin B, Jarnol, and Myricetin-and systematically assessed their interaction with Alzheimer's-relevant hub-bottleneck (H-B) genes using molecular docking, gene expression integration, network pharmacology, and molecular dynamics simulations. Our findings delineate a dual mechanistic model of DB's action: (1) an Estrogen Signaling Module centered around ESR1 and its key signaling associates (MAPK1, MAPK8, AKT1, EGFR, PIK3CA, and MAP2K1), forming a tightly interconnected, feedback-regulated pathway modulating memory, synaptic plasticity, neuroprotection, and inflammation; and (2) a Cholinergic Module involving direct inhibition of ACHE, providing rapid symptomatic relief. Molecular docking and dynamic simulations confirmed the strong and stable interactions of DB bioactives with both ESR1 and ACHE, showing comparable or superior stability to reference drugs (Estradiol and Donepezil). Regulatory network analysis revealed that ESR1 is one of the most connected genes in hippocampal-specific PPI networks and is co-regulated by numerous miRNAs and transcription factors. Co-expression analysis identified additional AD-relevant genes (e.g., PIK3R1, MAPK14, PTEN, DHODH, CAV1) involved in synaptic signaling, oxidative stress, and neurogenesis, while TF-miRNA coregulatory nodes such as miR-199a-3p, miR-181a-5p, GATA2, CREB1, and HINFP added further mechanistic layers to DB's network modulation. KEGG and GO enrichment analyses mapped DB-targeted genes to critical AD pathways, including Estrogen signaling, MAPK, PI3K-AKT, TNF, FoxO, and the Alzheimer's disease pathway itself. This multi-targeted, systems-level modulation by DB underscores its potential not only as a neuroprotective nutraceutical-especially for postmenopausal women vulnerable to estrogen loss-but also as a promising adjuvant to standard AD therapies.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种多因素神经退行性疾病，其特征为认知衰退、胆碱能功能障碍、突触丢失和神经炎症。现有疗法如多奈哌齐（Donepezil）和雌激素替代治疗仅提供症状缓解，因其还原论、单靶点的方法而未能解决疾病的复杂性。在本研究中，我们采用整合性系统生物学框架评估黄独（Dioscorea bulbifera, DB）的神经治疗潜力，DB是美国专利复方草药制剂BHD（包含假马齿苋（Bacopa monnieri）、沙棘（Hippophae rhamnoides）和DB）的核心组分，该制剂在临床前模型中显示出有前景的神经保护特性。我们鉴定了DB的活性植物成分——包括大黄素（Emodin）、β-谷甾醇（Beta-sitosterol）、薯蓣皂苷元（Diosgenin）、豆甾醇（Stigmasterol）、黄独素B（Diosbulbin B）、Jarnol和杨梅素（Myricetin）——并利用分子对接（molecular docking）、基因表达整合、网络药理学和分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）系统评估了它们与阿尔茨海默病相关枢纽-瓶颈（hub-bottleneck, H-B）基因的相互作用。我们的研究结果描绘了DB作用的双重机制模型：（1）一个以ESR1及其关键信号关联因子（MAPK1、MAPK8、AKT1、EGFR、PIK3CA和MAP2K1）为中心的雌激素信号模块，形成一个紧密互连、反馈调节的通路，调节记忆、突触可塑性、神经保护和炎症；（2）一个涉及直接抑制ACHE的胆碱能模块，提供快速症状缓解。分子对接和动力学模拟证实了DB生物活性成分与ESR1和ACHE的强且稳定的相互作用，其稳定性与参考药物（雌二醇（Estradiol）和多奈哌齐）相当或更优。调控网络分析揭示，ESR1是海马特异性PPI网络中连接度最高的基因之一，并受众多miRNA和转录因子共同调控。共表达分析识别出额外的AD相关基因（如PIK3R1、MAPK14、PTEN、DHODH、CAV1），这些基因参与突触信号传导、氧化应激和神经发生，而TF-miRNA共调控节点如miR-199a-3p、miR-181a-5p、GATA2、CREB1和HINFP为DB的网络调节增加了进一步的机制层面。KEGG和GO富集分析将DB靶向基因映射到关键的AD通路，包括雌激素信号、MAPK、PI3K-AKT、TNF、FoxO以及阿尔茨海默病通路本身。DB的这种多靶点、系统层面的调节强调了其潜力，不仅作为神经保护性营养保健品——特别是对于易受雌激素缺失影响的绝经后女性——而且作为标准AD疗法的有前景的辅助治疗。
